authorize.title: Authorize DevPulse CLI
authorize.subtitle: Approve access so your terminal can sync AI coding sessions.
authorize.invalidBody: Run devpulse login in your terminal to open a fresh authorization page.
authorize.needTeam: You need to join or create a team before connecting the CLI.
authorize.deviceNameHelp: Shown in Settings → Connected devices so you can revoke access later.
authorize.failed: Authorization failed. Try running devpulse login again.
authorize.doneBody: Your browser will briefly open 127.0.0.1 to hand the token to the CLI on your machine. That localhost step is expected.
authorize.doneClose: You can close this tab once the terminal shows a success message.
